items.titleLinesNote: two paragraphs; first wraps → renders 3 lines
items.body: Licensed in every corridor we serve. The regulatory work is done before you get there, so compliance is never your problem.

items.title: Stablecoin settlement live
items.body: Official Circle and Tether partner. Exclusive issuer of PHPC. Stablecoin settlement wired directly into local payment rails in every corridor.

items.title: Multi-currency reach
items.body:
Accept in one currency, pay out in another. 
Fiat or stablecoin. 
One integration covers every corridor we serve, and we keep adding more.

items.title:
One API. 
Every product.
items.body: Payments, disbursements, trading, and virtual accounts through a single API. One partner, one contract, one dashboard for everything.

items.title: Built to scale with you
items.body:
Philippines live today. 
7 more corridors rolling through 2026. As your business grows into new markets, we're already there or on the way.
